title: Canonical raw ambient complete coefficient scalar system
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and the directed finite intermediate fields $E$ of [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set], in the independent universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $W$ be a noetherian finite-dimensional scheme with $\ell$ invertible at every stalk. Let $\mathcal O_E$ and $\varpi_E$ be as in [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], with completed coefficient datum of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Let $\mathcal B_E(W)$ be the full subcategory of intrinsically derived-complete complexes of [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion], with no constructibility or boundedness restriction, and let $\mathcal R_E(W)=\mathcal B_E(W)[1/\varpi_E]$ be its raw central scalar localization [def-weil-linear-scalar-localization]. For $E\subset F$, restrict the actual completed derived tensor $C_{F/E,W}$ of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension] to complete complexes, using finite freeness and cofinality of uniformizer powers. Localize this tensor: on a simple localized arrow $u\otimes c$, use $C_{F/E,W}(u)\otimes c$ with $c\in E\subset F$. Normalize the repeated-field transition literally to the identity; the comparison with the integral tensor in that case is the inverse of its specified tensor unit. For a tower, use the integral balanced tensor associator, extended uniquely by localization and conjugated by these integral comparison maps. These transitions are additive; their associators have the two unit normalizations and the pentagon for four nested fields. The resulting coherent raw ambient scalar system is the StageSystem whose transitions and associators are precisely these canonical data. No Karoubi completion or common-stage pair construction is made in this definition.
